# Website phone mockup

Source for `website/assets/screenshot.webp` and `screenshot.png`: three iPhones showing Sources, Library and Settings.

    python3 build.py   # writes phones.html
    # render phones.html at 1440x900, device scale 2, transparent background,
    # then resize to 2000x1250 for the website

Edit the lists in `build.py` to change what each screen shows. Icons are Solar (line) from Iconify.
